next.reason: 1985: "The PADDING CHARACTER clause specifies the character which is to be used for block padding on sequential files."; 2023: "No PADDING CHARACTER clause among the 2023 file-control clauses; BLOCK CONTAINS only mentions padding as area outside a record". No 2023 clause holds the PADDING CHARACTER feature. No candidate defines a padding character or bypassing/filling padding on input/output, so the clause is dropped.
